relationships.subject: TNFα
relationships.evidence_quote: We demonstrate that TNFα is overexpressed in human oral cancer tissues and correlates with increased self-reported pain in patients.

key_findings: TNFα is elevated in human oral cancer tissue and correlates with patient pain; the TNFα antagonist C-87 reduced tumor growth, cytokines and nociception in mice.
TNFα and oral cancer activate Schwann cells, which release TNFα and NGF and induce nociception; hypoxia raised ADAM17 in Schwann cells.
